title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
欲復乎三代之治使當時擢居相位以行
其道其嘉謀嘉績豈軼韓范富歐而道學
著述又特過之之數君子所以不得大用
於當世者時也曾謂才力之不逮哉孔明
出師二表與伊訓說命相為表裏八陣一
圖與六韜三畧同為指南所謂具王佐之
才者也卞壼忠於事上而成仁廉以自持
而不污所謂有忠貞之節者也一則不能
興復漢室一則不能再造晉祚者天也是
===
果才力之不逮哉向使孔明卞壼有前數
君子之時居前數君子之位吾知下壼匹
休蕭曹丙魏而已矣孔明則伊呂三代
矣若孔明則伊呂三代之治可復也
曾蕭曹丙魏之儔所可得而抗衡邪詩曰
高山仰止景行行止書曰罔俾阿衡專美
有商愚也學不足以明體才不足以適用
其於漢唐宋諸君子景仰蓋有年矣他日
倘得出而見用必當誦詩讀書尚友千古
punctuated: 欲復乎三代之治，使當時擢居相位以行其道，其嘉謀嘉績，豈軼韓、范、富、歐，而道學著述，又特過之。之數君子所以不得大用於當世者，時也，曾謂才力之不逮哉？孔明《出師》二表，與《伊訓》、《說命》相為表裏；《八陣》一圖，與《六韜》、《三畧》同為指南，所謂具王佐之才者也。卞壼忠於事上而成仁，廉以自持而不污，所謂有忠貞之節者也。一則不能興復漢室，一則不能再造晉祚者，天也，是果才力之不逮哉？向使孔明、卞壼有前數君子之時，居前數君子之位，吾知下壼匹休蕭、曹、丙、魏而已矣，孔明則伊、呂三代矣，若孔明則伊、呂三代之治可復也，曾蕭、曹、丙、魏之儔所可得而抗衡邪？《詩》曰：「高山仰止，景行行止。」《書》曰：「罔俾阿衡，專美有商。」愚也學不足以明體，才不足以適用，其於漢、唐、宋諸君子，景仰蓋有年矣。他日倘得出而見用，必當誦《詩》讀《書》，尚友千古，
translation_en:
…wishing to restore the governance of the Three Dynasties: had they been promoted at that time to occupy the position of chief councilor in order to put their Way into practice, how would their admirable counsels and admirable achievements have been surpassed by [?] Han Qi 韓琦, Fan Zhongyan 范仲淹, Fu Bi 富弼, and Ouyang Xiu 歐陽脩, while their Learning of the Way and literary writings moreover particularly exceeded theirs! The reason these several gentlemen failed to be employed on a grand scale in their own times was timing; could it really be said that their talents and strengths fell short?

Kongming's 孔明 (Zhuge Liang 諸葛亮) two Memorials on Dispatching the Troops (Chushi biao) form the outer and inner counterparts of the Instructions of Yi (Yi xun) and the Charge to Yue (Yue ming); his single Diagram of the Eight Formations (Bazhen tu) serves together with the Six Secret Teachings (Liu tao) and Three Strategies (San lüe) as a compass and guide—he is what is called one who possessed the talent to assist a true king. Bian Kun 卞壼 was loyal in serving his superior and died to achieve benevolence, and maintained himself with integrity without being defiled—he is what is called one who possessed the moral steadfastness of loyalty and constancy. That the one could not revive and restore the House of Han, and the other could not rebuild the imperial fortune of Jin, was due to Heaven; was this truly because their talents and strengths fell short? Suppose in the past Kongming and Bian Kun had enjoyed the times of those several earlier gentlemen and occupied the positions of those several earlier gentlemen: I know that Bian [written 下] Kun would at least have matched the excellence of Xiao He 蕭何, Cao Can 曹參, Bing Ji 丙吉, and Wei Xiang 魏相; as for Kongming, he would have been like Yi Yin 伊尹 and Lü Shang 呂尚 of the Three Dynasties [? duplicate line in transcription: "as for Kongming, the governance of Yi Yin, Lü Shang, and the Three Dynasties could have been restored"]. How could the likes of Xiao He, Cao Can, Bing Ji, and Wei Xiang ever have been able to rival him?

The Book of Odes (Shi) says: "The high mountain, one looks up to it; the great road, one travels upon it." The Book of Documents (Shu) says: "Do not let Aheng (Yi Yin) monopolize the glory of Yin-Shang." Ignorant as I am, my learning is insufficient to illuminate the fundamental substance, and my talent is insufficient to meet practical application, yet for all those gentlemen of the Han, Tang, and Song, I have looked up to them in admiration for years. Some day, should I gain the opportunity to go forth into service and be employed, I shall surely recite the Odes, read the Documents, and befriend the ancients across a thousand ages…

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
等而上之以求底于臯夔稷契伊傅周召
之地而後已等使三代以下之相業人物
專藝於其前識性覲執事進而教之幸甚
第四問　　　　　　　　　陳璧
同考試官訓導王　批筆力滂沛可嘉
同考試官教諭蔣　批鋪叙詳而斷制嚴
作手也
考試官教諭戴　批善荅所問偉哉
===
考試官教諭唐　批敷荅詳整
學校得其人而斯道所由明科目得其人
而斯道所由重蓋道在人心未嘗或泯古
者學校科目之得人固足以為斯道之光
矣然則後人有事於學校科目之間而欲
如古人之有光含道將安求哉請因明問
而條陳之學校之設肇于三代而盛于我
朝既任校官以典其教復補生徒以肄其業
将使成人有德小子有造以俟世之所用
punctuated:
等而上之，以求底于臯、夔、稷、契、伊、傅、周、召之地而後已。等使三代以下之相業人物，專藝於其前識？性覲執事進而教之，幸甚。

第四問　陳璧
同考試官訓導王　批：筆力滂沛，可嘉。
同考試官教諭蔣　批：鋪叙詳而斷制嚴，作手也。
考試官教諭戴　批：善荅所問，偉哉！
考試官教諭唐　批：敷荅詳整。

學校得其人，而斯道所由明；科目得其人，而斯道所由重。蓋道在人心，未嘗或泯。古者學校、科目之得人，固足以為斯道之光矣。然則後人有事於學校、科目之間，而欲如古人之有光含道，將安求哉？請因明問而條陳之。學校之設，肇于三代，而盛于我朝。既任校官以典其教，復補生徒以肄其業，将使成人有德、小子有造，以俟世之所用……
translation_en:
…ascending step by step, stopping only after seeking to reach the level of Gao Yao 臯陶, Kui 夔, Hou Ji 后稷, Xie 契, Yi Yin 伊尹, Fu Yue 傅說, the Duke of Zhou 周公, and the Duke of Shao 召公. How could I let [?] the ministerial achievements and figures from the Three Dynasties onward monopolize excellence before us [?]? I only hope [?] that the examiners will bring me forward and instruct me; I would be most fortunate.

Fourth Question — Chen Bi 陳璧
Associate Examiner and Assistant Instructor Wang 王 comments: The force of the brush is torrential and abundant; it is commendable.
Associate Examiner and Instructor Jiang 蔣 comments: The exposition is detailed and the judgments are rigorous; this is the work of a skilled hand.
Examiner and Instructor Dai 戴 comments: It answers what was asked well; magnificent indeed!
Examiner and Instructor Tang 唐 comments: The elaborated response is detailed and well-ordered.

When schools obtain the right men, this Way is thereby illuminated; when the examination system obtains the right men, this Way is thereby accorded weight. Indeed, the Way resides in the human mind and has never been extinguished. In antiquity, when schools and examination categories obtained the right men, it was truly sufficient to bring glory to this Way. This being so, if men of later times who are engaged in the realms of schools and examinations wish, like the ancients, to bring glory to this [?] Way, where then should they seek it? Please allow me to set this forth item by item in response to your clear question. The establishment of schools began in the Three Dynasties and flourishes in our dynasty. Having appointed school officials to take charge of instruction, the state further enrolls students to practice their studies, intending to cause grown men to have virtue and young men to make progress, so as to await employment by the world…

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
也苟匪其人能不爲斯道玷乎惟近代安
定胡瑗之爲人也其體則仁義禮樂其文
則詩書史傳故以之教授蘇湖嚴立教條
當時之從其門者彬彬其盛若錢藻諸人
深明體用之學見用當時留芳簡冊此無
他師道立而善人多也科舉之制始于隋
唐而盛於我
朝每三載以賓興賢能命有司以典貢舉將
使賢才彙進俊乂奮庸以爲世之所用也苟
===
匪其人能不爲斯道累乎惟近代司馬君
實之爲人也至誠自得之學見於立朝行
已之間俯仰無愧之誠著於愛國忠君之
際故以之持衡宋室奬拔士類當時之就
廷試者濟濟其盛若蘇轍之策獨敷正直
之對切中時政擢在優選此無他對者之
是非在考官之去取也然時有古今人無
古今人有古今道無古今今之建學育才
不徒藪賓人才之學尤且責備校官之教
punctuated: 也。苟匪其人，能不爲斯道玷乎？惟近代安定胡瑗之爲人也，其體則仁義禮樂，其文則詩書史傳，故以之教授蘇、湖，嚴立教條，當時之從其門者，彬彬其盛。若錢藻諸人，深明體用之學，見用當時，留芳簡冊。此無他，師道立而善人多也。科舉之制，始于隋、唐，而盛於我朝。每三載以賓興賢能，命有司以典貢舉，將使賢才彙進，俊乂奮庸，以爲世之所用也。苟匪其人，能不爲斯道累乎？惟近代司馬君實之爲人也，至誠自得之學，見於立朝行已之間；俯仰無愧之誠，著於愛國忠君之際。故以之持衡宋室，奬拔士類，當時之就廷試者，濟濟其盛。若蘇轍之策，獨敷正直之對，切中時政，擢在優選。此無他，對者之是非，在考官之去取也。然時有古今，人無古今；人有古今，道無古今。今之建學育才，不徒藪賓人才之學，尤且責備校官之教，
translation_en:
… awaits being put to use by the world. If they are not the right people, how can this not be a blemish upon this Way? Consider the character of Hu Yuan 胡瑗 (Mr. Anding 安定) in recent eras: for substance he took benevolence, righteousness, ritual, and music; for literary expression he took the Odes, the Documents, the histories, and the commentaries. Therefore, when he served as Instructor in Suzhou 蘇州 and Huzhou 湖州, he strictly established educational regulations, and those who studied under his gate at the time were flourishing and refined. Men such as Qian Zao 錢藻 and others deeply understood the learning of substance and function; they were employed in their own time and left a fragrant reputation in the historical records. This was for no other reason than that when the way of the teacher is established, good men become numerous.

The system of civil service examinations began in the Sui and Tang dynasties and has reached its flourishing height in our Dynasty. Every three years, worthy and able men are recommended and presented as guests of the state, and the competent authorities are commanded to take charge of the tribute examinations, so that worthy talents may advance together and outstanding men may rise to service, to be put to use by the world. If they are not the right people, how can this not be an encumbrance upon this Way? Consider the character of Sima Junshi 司馬君實 (Sima Guang 司馬光) in recent eras: his learning of utmost sincerity and personal realization was manifest between his standing at court and his personal conduct; his sincerity, leaving nothing to be ashamed of before heaven and earth, was evident in his love of state and loyalty to his ruler. Therefore, when he held the scales of evaluation for the Song house and encouraged and selected scholars, those who presented themselves for the court examination at the time were numerosos and flourishing. In the case of the policy essay of Su Zhe 蘇轍, he alone set forth a forthright and upright reply that hit squarely upon contemporary governance, and he was selected for high honors. This was for no other reason than that the right and wrong of those who reply depends upon what the Examiners accept and reject.

Yet while times have ancient and modern, human nature has no ancient or modern; while people belong to ancient or modern times, the Way has no ancient or modern. Today, in establishing schools and nurturing talent, the court not only verifies in practice [?] the learning of men of talent, but even more demands perfection in the teaching of school officials; …

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
良法美意可謂盡矣邇者又命憲臣以督
學政則校官也人才也彼此皆不可辭其
責也使為校官者以道自任以勤自處以
法前日胡瑗施教之方訓誨一時之人將
有明體適用之士若鐵藻者出以副
上之作養矣爲憲臣之督而後得其才乎今
之設科取士不徒嚴禁人才於掉鞅之日
尤必防閑有司於考校之際良法美意可
謂至矣曩者又定解額以嚴選舉則有司
===
也人才也彼此皆不可逃其咎也使典文
衡者以道自任以正自持以法前日司馬
君實選士之心去取一時之人將有持正
守道之士若蘇轍者出以副
上之簡拔矣何俟解額之限而後得其人乎
雖然待文王而後興者凡民也若夫豪傑
之士雖無文王猶興誠使學者不以凡民
自棄而以豪傑自期則學校之所育者莫
非明體適用之人科目之所取者罔匪持
punctuated: 良法美意，可謂盡矣。邇者又命憲臣以督學政，則校官也，人才也，彼此皆不可辭其責也。使為校官者以道自任，以勤自處，以法前日胡瑗施教之方，訓誨一時之人，將有明體適用之士若鐵藻者出，以副上之作養矣，爲憲臣之督而後得其才乎？今之設科取士，不徒嚴禁人才於掉鞅之日，尤必防閑有司於考校之際，良法美意，可謂至矣。曩者又定解額以嚴選舉，則有司也，人才也，彼此皆不可逃其咎也。使典文衡者以道自任，以正自持，以法前日司馬君實選士之心，去取一時之人，將有持正守道之士若蘇轍者出，以副上之簡拔矣，何俟解額之限而後得其人乎？雖然，待文王而後興者，凡民也；若夫豪傑之士，雖無文王猶興。誠使學者不以凡民自棄，而以豪傑自期，則學校之所育者，莫非明體適用之人；科目之所取者，罔匪持…
translation_en:
…such sound regulations and admirable intentions may well be called exhaustive. Recently, Censorial Officials have also been commissioned to supervise educational administration, so that neither educational officials nor men of talent can shirk their respective responsibilities. If those who serve as educational officials take the Way as their own responsibility, conduct themselves with diligence, and emulate the teaching methods of Hu Yuan 胡瑗 in former times to instruct the people of the age, then scholars who understand fundamental principles and can apply them in practice, such as Qian Zao 錢藻 [transcribed as Tie Zao 鐵藻, ?], will emerge to fulfill the Emperor's nurturing care. Why must one wait [reading 爲 as 焉, ?] for the supervision of Censorial Officials before obtaining such talent?

Today, in establishing the examination categories to select scholars, not only are strict prohibitions placed upon candidates on the day they compete in the arena, but rigorous precautions are also enforced upon the authorities during the grading process; such sound regulations and admirable intentions may well be called consummate. In the past, provincial quotas were also fixed to make selection strict, so that neither the authorities nor the candidates can escape blame for their failings. If those who preside over the literary balance take the Way as their own responsibility, maintain themselves in rectitude, and emulate the mind of Sima Junshi 司馬君實 (Sima Guang 司馬光) in selecting scholars in former times when accepting or rejecting the people of the age, then scholars who uphold rectitude and guard the Way, such as Su Zhe 蘇轍, will emerge to fulfill the Emperor's selection. Why wait for the restriction of provincial quotas before obtaining the right men?

Even so, those who wait for King Wen before rising up are ordinary folk; as for heroic scholars, they rise up even without a King Wen. If scholars truly do not abandon themselves as ordinary folk, but instead aspire to be heroes, then those nurtured by the schools will all be men who understand fundamental principles and can apply them in practice, and those selected through the examination categories will without exception be [scholars] who uphold…

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
正守道之士而錢藻蘇轍之儔不得專義
於其前矣何患斯道之不明不行哉謹以
是爲終篇獻
第五問
郭定
同考試官教諭蔣　批〔五策俱善答而此策尤他作鮮儷足見用世之學〕
考試官教諭戴　批〔鋪陳時政甚當〕
考試官教諭唐　批〔似此策手令人起敬〕
===
治道莫先於急務爲治莫要於得人夫得
勇智才略之人以備邊儲運則用力省而
成功多得豈弟公明之人以安民息訟則
處事周而見效速此理勢之必然古今之
通議宜有以塵執事之下詢於承學也愚
不敏敢不條陳其萬一乎且山西古冀州
也北連朔漠關塞險阻南距河流人民浩
繁今之急務備邊爲先儲運次之而安民
息訟則又素所行之而未效者也如邊境
punctuated:
正守道之士，而錢藻、蘇轍之儔，不得專義於其前矣。何患斯道之不明、不行哉？謹以是爲終篇獻。

第五問
郭定
同考試官教諭蔣　批〔五策俱善答，而此策尤他作鮮儷，足見用世之學。〕
考試官教諭戴　批〔鋪陳時政甚當。〕
考試官教諭唐　批〔似此策手，令人起敬。〕

治道莫先於急務，爲治莫要於得人。夫得勇智才略之人以備邊、儲運，則用力省而成功多；得豈弟公明之人以安民、息訟，則處事周而見效速。此理勢之必然，古今之通議，宜有以塵執事之下詢於承學也。愚不敏，敢不條陳其萬一乎？且山西，古冀州也。北連朔漠，關塞險阻；南距河流，人民浩繁。今之急務，備邊爲先，儲運次之，而安民、息訟則又素所行之而未效者也。如邊境
translation_en:
… scholars who uphold rectitude and cleave to the Way, so that the likes of Qian Zao 錢藻 and Su Zhe 蘇轍 will not monopolize righteousness [or: excellence, reading 美 for 義?] in earlier ages. What worry would there be that this Way is not illuminated and put into practice? I respectfully offer this as the conclusion of my essay.

Fifth Question
Guo Ding 郭定
Associate Examiner, Instructor Jiang 蔣 comments: [All five policy questions are well answered, and this policy essay in particular has few peers among the other compositions; it suffices to show his learning for practical statecraft.]
Examiner, Instructor Dai 戴 comments: [His exposition of current governance is very apt.]
Examiner, Instructor Tang 唐 comments: [A hand at policy essays like this inspires respect.]

In the way of governance, nothing comes before urgent tasks; in practicing governance, nothing is more essential than obtaining the right men. Now, if we obtain men of courage, wisdom, talent, and strategic acumen to prepare the frontiers and manage grain transport and storage, then the effort expended will be slight while the achievements will be many. If we obtain men who are affable, impartial, and discerning to pacify the people and put an end to litigation, then affairs will be handled thoroughly and results will be seen swiftly. This is the inevitable course of principle and circumstance, and the consensus of antiquity and the present; it is fitting that it has occupied Your Excellency's attention in putting this inquiry to us junior scholars. Though I am dull-witted, how dare I not set forth a tiny fraction of what I know item by item? Moreover, Shanxi is the ancient province of Jizhou 冀州. To the north it adjoins the northern deserts, with strategic passes and rugged terrain; to the south it reaches the Yellow River, with a vast and populous citizenry. Among today's urgent tasks, frontier defense comes first, followed by grain storage and transport, while pacifying the people and ending litigation are measures long practiced without yet achieving full effect. For instance, on the frontier…

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
可慮者雲中鴈門諸處為最甚邊儲所仰
者冀寧河東諸道所當先洪惟
聖朝嘗選將練兵以固其守飛芻走粟以實其
邊宜其邊壓不驚而大倉之積陳陳相因
矣然而醜虜尚為邊患士卒尚慮不給者
無他盖備邊貴得勇智之人隨機應變防
患於未然儲邊貴得才略之士因時制宜
設法於將然為今之計莫若愼擇勇智之
將而居總戎之職惟專其任不分其權使
===
之脩明紀律練習士伍如書所謂事事有
備吾知內脩外攘軍民安輯而可以鞭笞
四夷矣精選才畧之士以任督運之官惟
重其職不奪其守俾之嚴其約束督其所
部如書所謂董之用威吾見邊儲充裕將
士賈勇而可以立功萬里矣尚何醜虜之
為患士卒之不給乎回視趙充國上屯田
方略恙戎畏服蕭何轉漕調兵粮道不絕
風斯下矣民收可慮者四境流離之當恤
punctuated: 可慮者，雲中、鴈門諸處為最甚；邊儲所仰者，冀寧、河東諸道所當先。洪惟聖朝嘗選將練兵以固其守，飛芻走粟以實其邊，宜其邊壓不驚，而大倉之積陳陳相因矣。然而醜虜尚為邊患，士卒尚慮不給者，無他，盖備邊貴得勇智之人，隨機應變，防患於未然；儲邊貴得才略之士，因時制宜，設法於將然。為今之計，莫若愼擇勇智之將，而居總戎之職，惟專其任，不分其權，使之脩明紀律，練習士伍，如《書》所謂「事事有備」，吾知內脩外攘，軍民安輯，而可以鞭笞四夷矣；精選才畧之士，以任督運之官，惟重其職，不奪其守，俾之嚴其約束，督其所部，如《書》所謂「董之用威」，吾見邊儲充裕，將士賈勇，而可以立功萬里矣。尚何醜虜之為患、士卒之不給乎？回視趙充國上屯田方略，恙戎畏服；蕭何轉漕調兵，粮道不絕，風斯下矣。民收可慮者，四境流離之當恤；
translation_en: … areas of concern, places such as Yunzhong and Yanmen are the most severe; as for what border provisions rely upon, circuits such as Jining and Hedong must come first. Thinking deeply upon how our Sacred Dynasty has selected generals and trained troops to strengthen its defenses, and rushed fodder and grain to fill its frontiers, it ought to be that the border settlements [? 邊壓, for 邊鄙] are unalarmed and the stores in the Great Granary pile up layer upon aged layer. Yet the vile caitiffs still pose a menace on the frontier, and the soldiers still worry over insufficient supplies. The reason is none other than this: defending the frontier requires obtaining men of courage and wisdom who can adapt to changing circumstances and prevent disasters before they arise; provisioning the frontier requires obtaining gentlemen of talent and strategy who can devise measures suited to the times and establish methods for what is about to occur. For the present plan, nothing is better than carefully choosing generals of courage and wisdom to occupy the post of Supreme Commander, giving them exclusive responsibility and not dividing their authority, and having them clarify and enforce discipline and drill the ranks—just as the Book of Documents says, "Have every thing in readiness." Then I know that with internal governance cultivated and external threats repelled, soldiers and civilians will be at peace, and we will be able to whip the four barbarian tribes into submission. And we should carefully select gentlemen of talent and strategy to serve as officials supervising transport, giving weight to their office and not infringing upon their duties, enabling them to tighten their regulations and supervise their subordinates—just as the Book of Documents says, "Superintend them with majesty." Then I shall see border provisions become abundant, officers and men muster their courage, and meritorious deeds established ten thousand li away. How then could the vile caitiffs still be a menace, or the soldiers lack supplies? Looking back at Zhao Chongguo submitting his strategy for state farms so that the Qiang [? 恙, for 羌] and Rong submitted in awe, or Xiao He transporting grain by water and dispatching troops so that the supply lines were never broken, their achievements would seem inferior by comparison! As for matters of concern regarding the people's livelihood [? 民收, for 民牧 or 民瘼], the displaced wanderers within the four borders must be pitied; …

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
司牧可患者諸路訟牒之當弭洪惟
聖朝嘗布德宣化以厚其生命官折獄以導其
善宜其百姓安堵而禮義之化靡然從風
矣然而斯民未免轉徙於他境奸頑未免
日流於健訟者無他蓋安民貴得豈弟之
人奉宣德意輕傜而薄賦息訟貴得公明
之人推明教化正本而清源為今之計莫
若妙選豈弟之士以任承流宣化之職不
以徵科為急惟以德化為心於民之安生
===
樂業者加之以撫綏於民之流離困苦者
加之以招集如書所謂柔遠能邇吾知來
流移而安土者斯民靡不各安其生矣慎
簡公明之人以任激濁揚清之責不以苛
察為事惟以欽恤為心於人之守法循理
者加之以獎勵於人之徇利忘義者齊之
以刑罰如書所謂旌別淑慝吾見鋤強梗
而扶善良斯民靡不日遷於善矣尚何流
徙之不復健訟之不弭乎回視王成黃霸
punctuated: 司牧可患者，諸路訟牒之當弭。洪惟聖朝，嘗布德宣化以厚其生，命官折獄以導其善，宜其百姓安堵，而禮義之化靡然從風矣。然而斯民未免轉徙於他境，奸頑未免日流於健訟者，無他，蓋安民貴得豈弟之人，奉宣德意，輕傜而薄賦；息訟貴得公明之人，推明教化，正本而清源。為今之計，莫若妙選豈弟之士，以任承流宣化之職。不以徵科為急，惟以德化為心，於民之安生樂業者，加之以撫綏；於民之流離困苦者，加之以招集。如《書》所謂「柔遠能邇」，吾知來流移而安土者，斯民靡不各安其生矣。慎簡公明之人，以任激濁揚清之責。不以苛察為事，惟以欽恤為心，於人之守法循理者，加之以獎勵；於人之徇利忘義者，齊之以刑罰。如《書》所謂「旌別淑慝」，吾見鋤強梗而扶善良，斯民靡不日遷於善矣。尚何流徙之不復、健訟之不弭乎？回視王成、黃霸，
translation_en: … and what must distress those who shepherd the people is the need to put an end to litigation documents across all circuits. Humbly reflecting upon our sacred dynasty, it has broadcast virtue and proclaimed moral transformation to enrich the people's livelihood, and appointed officials to adjudicate lawsuits in order to guide them toward goodness. One would expect the common people to dwell in peace and to yield before the transforming influence of rites and righteousness like grass before the wind. Yet these people still cannot avoid wandering away into other regions, and thecrafty and obstinate still cannot avoid sinking daily into habitual litigation. There is no other reason for this than that pacifying the people depends upon obtaining affable and benevolent men who respectfully proclaim the imperial benevolent intentions, lightening corvée labor and reducing taxes; while ending litigation depends upon obtaining impartial and discerning men who extend and clarify moral instruction, rectifying the root and purifying the source. For a plan today, nothing surpasses carefully selecting affable and benevolent scholars to fill the offices that transmit the sovereign's grace and proclaim moral transformation. They should not treat tax collection as their urgent priority, but take moral transformation alone to heart: toward those among the people who live in peace and take pleasure in their occupations, they should apply soothing and pacification; toward those who are displaced and in distress, they should apply summoning and gathering. As the Book of Documents says, "Be gracious to the distant and cultivate the near." I know that by bringing back the displaced and settling the native-born, there will be none among the people who do not find peace in their livelihoods. We should also prudently select impartial and discerning men to bear the responsibility of sweeping away the corrupt and exalting the pure. They should not make harsh scrutiny their business, but take reverent compassion alone to heart: toward those who abide by the law and follow principle, they should bestow encouragement and reward; toward those who pursue profit and forget righteousness, they should regulate them with punishments and penalties. As the Book of Documents says, "Distinguish the good from the evil." I see that by weeding out the violent and refractory and supporting the good and honest, there will be none among the people who do not daily move toward goodness. How then could the displaced still fail to return, or habitual litigation still fail to cease? Looking back upon Wang Cheng 王成 and Huang Ba 黃霸, …

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
膠東戶口增至八萬餘口韓延壽在東郡
閉閤思過百姓感化有桱廷矣故曰知者
無不知也當務之為急謹述所聞以對
punctuated: 膠東戶口增至八萬餘口、韓延壽在東郡閉閤思過、百姓感化，有桱廷矣。故曰：「知者無不知也，當務之為急。」謹述所聞以對。
translation_en: … [Wang Cheng 王成 and Huang Ba 黃霸], under whom the registered population of Jiaodong 膠東 increased by more than eighty thousand individuals, and Han Yanshou 韓延壽 in Dong Commandery 東郡, who shut his cabinet doors to reflect on his faults until the common people were moved and transformed, it will be far superior indeed [to 桱廷 (徑庭)?]. Therefore it is said: "The wise know all things, yet they treat what is of pressing importance as the most urgent." I respectfully set forth what I have heard in reply.

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
山西鄉試錄後序
天順壬午秋當大比之期巡
按山西監察御史暨諸藩臬
重臣祗承
彝典舉行惟謹既而走聘儒紳
以司文衡合列郡士子抱藝
而集者環棘而群試之一時
===
監臨提調監試以及執事官
僚罔不恪盡乃心期在得人
以貢春官撤棘得士六十有
五次其姓名與其文之粹者
謹書成錄將以獻之
天府而達之四方謂會宜序諸
後書不云乎惟后非賢不乂
punctuated:
山西鄉試錄後序

天順壬午秋，當大比之期，巡按山西監察御史暨諸藩臬重臣，祗承彝典，舉行惟謹。既而走聘儒紳，以司文衡，合列郡士子抱藝而集者，環棘而群試之。一時監臨、提調、監試以及執事官僚，罔不恪盡乃心，期在得人，以貢春官。撤棘，得士六十有五，次其姓名與其文之粹者，謹書成錄，將以獻之天府，而達之四方，謂會宜序諸後。《書》不云乎：「惟后非賢不乂，
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Shanxi Provincial Examination

In the autumn of the renwu year of the Tianshun era (1462), which was the scheduled time for the triennial examination, the Regional Investigating Censor of Shanxi, together with the senior officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions, reverently upheld the established statutes and carried out the proceedings with utmost care. Thereafter, they dispatched invitations to Confucian scholars and gentry to take charge of evaluating the essays, and gathered the scholars from the various prefectures who had assembled with their literary skills, enclosing the compound with thorny brambles to examine them all together. At that time, the Supervising Officials, Proctors, Monitoring Officials, and the various administrative officers all devoted their hearts with reverence and diligence, hoping to select worthy men to present to the Ministry of Rites. When the thorny barrier was removed, sixty-five scholars had been selected. Having arranged their names in order along with the finest of their essays, the officials carefully transcribed them into a record to be presented to the imperial court and circulated throughout the four quarters; and they said that I, Hui, ought to write a postface at the end. Does the Book of Documents (Shu) not say: "The sovereign without the worthy cannot govern; …"

title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:

聖朝丕弘至治立賢無方而取士
之選獨重科目重科目所以
重經學也蓋經以載道道以
馭世經明則道明道明則天
下之事可從而理矣故有志
於用世者莫不由科目有志
===
於科目者罔不明經學是以
薄海內外靡然從風雖山林
韋布屯營飛騎之人亦皆爭
自磨濯共惟
帝臣以求是途進身爲快孰肯韜
光晦迹自負於
明時也哉易曰觀國之光利用

translation_en: … and without the sovereign, the worthy have none from whom to draw their sustenance"? Now our Sacred Dynasty has greatly expanded the utmost governance, establishing the worthy without fixed bounds, yet in the selection of scholars it places particular weight upon the civil-service examination categories. To place weight upon the examination categories is the means of placing weight upon the study of the Classics. For the Classics are that whereby the Way is conveyed, and the Way is that whereby the world is governed. When the Classics are illuminated, the Way is illuminated; when the Way is illuminated, the affairs of all under Heaven can thereby be put in order. Therefore, none who aspire to be of service to the world fail to proceed through the examination categories, and none who aspire to the examination categories fail to master the study of the Classics. For this reason, within and beyond the four seas, all bow before the wind in response. Even recluses in the mountains and forests clad in coarse cloth, and men among the garrison camps and swift cavalry, all vie to polish and cleanse themselves so as to serve together as subjects of the Emperor, taking delight in seeking advancement through this path. Who would be willing to hide his brilliance and obscure his traces, failing himself in an enlightened age? title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
賓于王詩曰鳳凰鳴矣于彼
高岡其以是歟矧諸士子生
長名藩樂育庠校養其根而
竢其實加其膏而希其光蓋
亦有年于茲者一旦懷抱利
器角藝文場推明聖人之道
而為文章皆足以鳴
===
國家之盛可謂不負
上之所需已之所學者矣登名
是錄亦宜矣哉行將奮六翮
翔千仞觀光
上國以縻好爵如鳳凰之鳴高
岡有日矣尚當精脩力踐砥
礪名節圖惟道濟天下使致
punctuated: 賓于王。」《詩》曰：「鳳凰鳴矣，于彼高岡。」其以是歟！矧諸士子生長名藩，樂育庠校，養其根而竢其實，加其膏而希其光，蓋亦有年于茲者。一旦懷抱利器，角藝文場，推明聖人之道而為文章，皆足以鳴國家之盛，可謂不負上之所需、已之所學者矣。登名是錄，亦宜矣哉！行將奮六翮、翔千仞，觀光上國，以縻好爵，如鳳凰之鳴高岡有日矣。尚當精脩力踐，砥礪名節，圖惟道濟天下，使致

How much more so for these scholars, born and raised in this renowned province and joyfully nurtured in its schools—nourishing their roots while awaiting their fruit, replenishing their lamp oil while hoping for its brilliance—who have indeed spent years doing so until now! Once they come forth carrying their sharp instruments to compete in the literary arena, expounding and illuminating the Way of the Sages to compose essays that are all sufficient to proclaim the flourishing of the State, they may truly be said to have been worthy of both what the Sovereign requires and what they themselves have studied. title: 天順六年山西鄉試錄
text:
君澤民之術不徒托諸空言
又必見諸行事將斯舉也匪
直科目之光而已斯文之光
邦家之光也魯不敏忝竽校讐
之末故書此以紀遭際之盛
且爲諸士子勗云
直隷河間府景州東光縣儒
學教諭戴魯序
punctuated:
君澤民之術，不徒托諸空言，又必見諸行事。將斯舉也，匪直科目之光而已，斯文之光，邦家之光也。魯不敏，忝竽校讐之末，故書此以紀遭際之盛，且爲諸士子勗云。
直隷河間府景州東光縣儒學教諭戴魯序。
translation_en:
… sovereign to moral perfection and conferring blessings upon the people are not merely consigned to empty words, but are unfailingly manifested in actual deeds. In this way, this recruitment will be not merely the glory of the examination system alone, but the glory of This Culture of Ours and the glory of the state! Though I, Lu, lack acuity, I have unworthily occupied a place at the end of the ranks of those collating and examining the papers. Therefore, I write this to record the splendor of this fortunate occasion, and also to encourage all the scholars.
Postface by Dai Lu 戴魯, Instructor of the Confucian School of Dongguang County 東光縣 in Jingzhou 景州, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸).
